after the order window closes nothing more moves; every Hungarian host closes and its remaining order cohort (2 people) is released at home; no campaign death is recorded inside Hungary; registered = deported + released

no killing role at state 88: nothing is registered, moved or recorded

halt: Hungary loses stability and war support, Germany resents it, Germany is told once and its Records gain one halt entry; at the next monthly pass every Hungarian host closes through the ordinary closure, 85849 people are released at home with no death recorded, no train leaves after June, and the order never reopens
a German subject that halts the deportations also loses autonomy
